_comment: Copy to media/library/library.json and put the files next to it (media/ is not versioned). Only register files obtained from official channels. rights_basis: own | licensed | press_kit | rockstar_fan_policy. rockstar_fan_policy = non-commercial only (https://support.rockstargames.com/articles/7bNaeoMFTV0iUDGhStTXvz): productions using it are flagged 'do not monetise'. Leaked or spoiler material is rejected.
